description: Source code for managing CID font objects in the FreeType project, including functions for initializing, finalizing, and handling font sizes and faces.

methods.name: cid_slot_done
methods.description: Resets glyph hints in a glyph slot.

methods.name: cid_slot_init
methods.description: Initializes glyph hints for a glyph slot, using the pshinter service if available.

methods.name: cid_size_get_globals_funcs
methods.description: Retrieves the global functions for a given size, using the pshinter service.

methods.name: cid_size_done
methods.description: Finalizes a size object, destroying internal globals if present.

methods.name: cid_size_init
methods.description: Initializes a size object, creating internal globals via the pshinter service.

methods.name: cid_size_request
methods.description: Requests size metrics and sets scale for the size object.

methods.name: cid_face_done
methods.description: Finalizes a CID face object, freeing allocated resources.

methods.name: cid_face_init
methods.description: Initializes a CID face object, loading font data and setting face properties.
